context: A uni student listens to his teen friend recap recent events
purpose: Teach: 凄く/きのう/ふたつ/即ち/如何/念頭/先ず/一昨日

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先輩、聞いてよー!一昨日めっちゃ大変だったの、もう散々だった。
lines.en: Senpai, listen! The day before yesterday was crazy, totally awful.
lines.style: Teen girl excited rapid casual upward rising tone

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 一昨日?そういえばLINEの返事も無かったよね。何があったの?
lines.en: Day before yesterday? Come to think of it, you didn't reply on LINE either. What happened?
lines.style: Calm uni guy slightly teasing warm older brother vibe

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: それがね、きのうの夜やっと落ち着いたんだけど、まず駅で財布落として、その後ふたつも続けてトラブルがあって。
lines.en: Well, things finally settled down last night, but first I dropped my wallet at the station, then two more troubles in a row.
lines.style: Teen girl breathless storytelling building suspense gradually faster

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 財布落としたって、それ結構ヤバいじゃん。ちゃんと念頭に置いて気をつけなきゃダメだよ。
lines.en: You dropped your wallet? That's pretty serious. You've gotta keep that in mind and be careful.
lines.style: Uni guy half-scolding half-amused gentle laugh in voice

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: それがさ、駅員さんが超丁寧で「お忘れ物の状況は如何でしたか」って聞いてきて、ウケるんだけど。
lines.en: So the station guy was super formal and asked 'what was the situation of your lost item' — it was hilarious.
lines.style: Teen girl giggling mimicking formal speech with dramatic flair

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: あはは、駅員さん丁寧すぎでしょ。即ち君が慌てすぎてたってことだね、たぶん。
lines.en: Haha, way too polite. In other words, you were probably just panicking too much.
lines.style: Uni guy teasing with warm chuckle gently amused tone

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ひどーい!でも最後は友達が財布届けてくれて、凄く嬉しかったんだよね。
lines.en: So mean! But in the end my friend brought my wallet back, and I was really happy.
lines.style: Teen girl mock-offended then melting into sincere warm gratitude

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: それはよかった。今度から先ず深呼吸して、落ち着いて行動しなよ。
lines.en: That's good to hear. From now on, first take a deep breath and act calmly.
lines.style: Uni guy concluding warmly caring older mentor tone soft
